exercises.question: Which sentence gives a cause?
options: La ciudad cambió debido a la falta de agua. [The city changed due to the lack of water.]
La ciudad cambió; por eso, hay menos agua. [The city changed; that is why there is less water.]
La ciudad cambió; sin embargo, sigue igual. [The city changed; however, it stays the same.]

exercises.sentence: El precio subió, ___ muchas personas cambiaron de plan.
exercises.english: The price went up; as a result, many people changed their plans.
Although it was difficult, we continued.

sentences: Primero, queremos evitar problemas. [First, we want to avoid problems.]
Después, estudiamos varias opciones. [Then we study several options.]
Finalmente, elegimos una solución. [Finally, we choose a solution.]

exercises.question: Which sentence combines contrast and consequence?
options: Era caro; sin embargo, lo compramos, por eso tuvimos que ahorrar. [It was expensive; however, we bought it, so we had to save.]
Era caro; sin embargo, decidimos esperar un poco más de tiempo. [It was expensive; however, we decided to wait a little longer.]
Compramos una casa nueva, por eso tuvimos que ahorrar mucho tiempo. [We bought a new house, so we had to save for a long time.]

exercises.english: The objective is to achieve good results.
The measure is useful because it reduces costs.

exercises.question: Which sentence best integrates the unit?
options: El proyecto es necesario porque hay un problema; sin embargo, debe ser económico para que pueda funcionar. [The project is necessary because there is a problem; however, it must be economical so that it can work.]
El proyecto nuevo ya existe y cuenta con el apoyo de todos los vecinos de la ciudad. [The new project already exists and has the support of all the city's neighbours.]
Hay un problema de transporte en las calles principales del centro de la ciudad. [There is a transport problem on the main streets of the city centre.]

exercises.sentence: El precio subió; como resultado, cambiamos de plan.
options: The price went up; as a result, we changed our plan.
The price went down; however, we stayed.
The price stayed the same.

exercises.sentence: A pesar de las dificultades, continuamos.
options: Despite the difficulties, we continued.
Because of the difficulties, we stopped.
There were no difficulties.

exercises.sentence: Es importante encontrar una solución para que todos puedan participar.
exercises.english: It is important to find a solution so that everyone can participate.

options: Ocurrió debido a la falta de transporte. [It happened due to the lack of transport.]
Ocurrió por eso la falta de transporte. [It happened therefore the lack of transport.]
Ocurrió debido la falta de transporte. [It happened due the lack of transport.]
Como resultado, tuvimos que cambiar de plan. [As a result, we had to change our plan.]
Porque tuvimos que cambiar de plan al final. [Because we had to change our plan in the end.]
Aunque tuvimos que cambiar de plan al final. [Although we had to change our plan in the end.]
El objetivo es mejorar el servicio. [The objective is to improve the service.]
El objetivo es porque el servicio. [The objective is because the service.]
El objetivo es mejoramos el servicio. [The objective is we improve the service.]

exercises.question: Which sentence best shows a balanced argument?
options: La solución es cara; sin embargo, puede lograr buenos resultados y proteger el entorno. [The solution is expensive; however, it can achieve good results and protect the environment.]
La solución propuesta resulta muy cara, por eso consideramos que no es buena. [The proposed solution turns out very expensive, so we consider it is not good.]
La solución que aprobó el ayuntamiento es buena y muy conveniente para todos. [The solution the city council approved is good and very convenient for everyone.]

template.prompt: Say there was little transport, so many people had problems (use por eso).
template.answer: Había poco transporte, por eso muchas personas tuvieron problemas.

template.prompt: Write a short argument: the project is necessary because there is a problem; however, it must be economical so that it can work; so we must look for a balanced solution.
template.answer: El proyecto es necesario porque hay un problema. Sin embargo, debe ser económico para que pueda funcionar. Por eso, debemos buscar una solución equilibrada.
